These bored members of the upper classes wage war from mobile fortresses and view the battlefield as their playground. Few in number, the Titan Lords usually offer their services as mercenaries, but on the rare occasions when they fight together, their armies of massive walkers are a spectacle to behold. With little fear of consequences for their actions, Titan Lords often wander from one battlefield to the next, seeking some sort of thrill or purpose that is lacking in their pampered lives. Within a relatively short time, humanity has managed to build up a large industrial base in their colonies throughout the Sirius Sector, and most of these are owned by a handful of powerful companies.... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/titan-lords) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Warbound: Enemies that roll to block hits from this model's weapons take 1 extra wound for each unmodified result of 1 that they roll. ### Special Rules Delayed Action: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ### Aura Special Rules Read more ### Spells Terrifying Fury (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which must take a morale test. If failed, it becomes fatigued. Flame of Destruction (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3). Fiery Protection (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Melee Evasion once (next time the effect would apply). Brutal Massacre (2): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 6 hits with Crack. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. War Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Warbound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Headtaker Strike (3): Pick up to two enemy units within 12", which take 3 hits with AP(2) each. ### Units ### Vehicles / Monsters War Vassal Micro-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 195pts Heavy Hammer(A1, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A3, AP(1)) Fear(1), Fortified, Tough(9), Warbound War Errant Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 295pts Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Furious, Tough(12), Warbound War Pilgrim Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 360pts Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Fortified, Tough(12), Warbound War Yeoman Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 470pts 2x Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Fear(2), Relentless, Tough(12), Warbound ### Titans War Paladin Light Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 490pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A6, AP(2)) Fear(3), Fortified, Tough(18), Warbound War Questor Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 710pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)), Titan Hammer(A4, AP(1), Blast(3)) Fear(4), Fortified, Furious, Tough(24), Warbound War Knight Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 835pts Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Fortified, Tough(24), Warbound War Duke Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1055pts 2x Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Fear(4), Relentless, Tough(24), Warbound War King Heavy Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1140pts Twin Shoulder-Cannon(24", A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), 2x Titan Harpoon Cannon(18", A1, AP(4), Deadly(9)), Twin Hull-Fuser(12", A2, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A10, AP(3)) Fear(4), Tough(30), Warbound Images: -
